title: Ask HN: Let's all sell our AI stocks, short Nvidia and pop the AI bubble
excerpt: AI is a generational attack on working people everywhere by the capitalized class.
content_html:
AI is a generational attack on working people everywhere by the capitalized class.

It has earned our animosity, especially if the attack looks like it will actually go through.

And, ironically, I don't think the capitalized even understand that they are building a giant guillotine for themselves, as if the buildout billions are well-spent, there would necessarily be a communist revolution, and it would be bloody. No one eats safely around the starving.

Without a horse in this race, I'm fascinated to see which the market chooses: machine-god + self-annihilation, or humiliation + bankruptcy.

Either way, there is nothing like the present configuration on the other side. Its a political, not technological, singularity.

content_html_zh:
人工智能是资本阶级对各地劳动人民的代际攻击。

它已经赢得了我们的敌意，特别是如果攻击看起来确实会发生的话。

而且，具有讽刺意味的是，我认为资本家甚至不明白他们正在为自己建造一座巨大的断头台，就好像数十亿美元的建设用得其所，必然会发生共产主义革命，而且会是血腥的。 挨饿的人身边没有人能安全进食。

这场比赛中没有一匹马，我很想知道市场会选择哪一个：机器之神+自我毁灭，还是羞辱+破产。

不管怎样，另一边的配置与目前的配置完全不同。 这是一个政治奇点，而非技术奇点。
